news.title: 'Where anti-Indian hatred can lead': US lawmaker Raja Krishnamoorthi's warning after plot targeting Aurora Hindu temple
news.description: US lawmaker Raja Krishnamoorthi condemns a white supremacist's plot to attack a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois, highlighting the rise of anti-Indian hatred and its potential for violence.

news.title: Actor Imran Khan to move Bombay HC against order to leave India
news.description: Actor Imran Khan has approached the Bombay High Court against an order for his deportation from India. The order was issued after his participation in a protest supporting the Cockroach Janata Party.

news.title: 中金黄金：预计前三季度归母净利润55.2亿元到58亿元，同比增长50.05%-57.66%
news.description: 36氪获悉，中金黄金公告，预计前三季度归母净利润55.2亿元到58亿元，同比增长50.05%-57.66%；扣非净利润55亿元到58亿元，同比增长30.53%-37.65%。业绩增长主要因金铜等主要金属价格同比上涨显著、硫酸等副产品增收及矿产金等核心业务毛利率同比大幅提升。
